This is not a fitted distribution and is retained only for price discipline.

That price swing is large enough to flag, and Rice's 2025 target/catch role plus independent analyst support makes 5.5 a legitimate candidate. Current discipline: WATCH Rice O5.5; exact play-to 5.5 and max acceptable price -110, with plus money strongly preferred if verified at a named regulated sportsbook. Other candidates remain non-actionable or priced beyond their ceilings.
